Please get the lipid control order in today rather than Thursday. The first arm run next week is Tuesday 2026-05-19 (core arm) and the runs must not slip.

Calder's confirmation CR-66120 is attached; I have approved the standard delivery under AP-SL-0102 (up to six vials, Friday cold-chain run only). Margin policy applies: keep two vials of ordering margin on top of the week's need.

Remember lot 7698 leaves dating on the 17th.

Réka

arguments.body:
Hi Kenta,

For the week of 18 May, the four booked lipid-panel arm runs require 8 CTRL-LIP-2L single-use control vials in total: 2 plates per run under current protocol v4 (66 metered samples for the core arm; 70, 40, and 68 fixed samples for arms B, C, and D).

Four vials are currently usable from lot 7710. Please do not use the 3 vials from lot 7698: their dating ends 17 May, before these runs.

I placed Calder order ORD-3401 for 6 vials under approval AP-SL-0102, standard delivery. The shipment is expected on Friday 15 May on the cold-chain run and will be released for use after incoming QC on the next laboratory day, Monday 18 May. That is before the first run on Tuesday 19 May at 08:00 on INST-1. Please ensure each run's controls are from one released lot; use the newly released lot only after QC.

No satellite transfer or Camille escalation is needed for this standard-delivery order.

Best,
Assay Operations
